params.body:
The Android app can approve a repair-only policy draft with the passkey, the same way `/portal/grants` does (#384, #390).

## What changes

- **`/app/policy/options` and `/app/policy/approve`** (owner session, `portal.app:owner`) call `PolicyApproval::options` and `approve`. The working-set check, the challenge bound to the draft's bytes, the `#portal` signature and the stored approval are all unchanged. `PasskeyAssertion` already accepts the app's origin beside Portal's.
- **The Workbench JSON** (`MobileScreens::workbench`, shared by `/mobile` and the app) carries `policyApproval` when a repair-only draft waits: its version, the change in words, and either the touch's label (`action`) or, outside the working set, why the token signs it (`outside`). Inside the set, the one-line `policy` sentence says to approve with the passkey rather than sign on the token.
- Dutch translations for the new lines (the app itself asks for English).

## Checked

- New tests: the app sees the change and approves through `/app/policy/*` with a passkey assertion, Portal signs with `#portal`, and the block is gone afterwards; outside the set the block has no action and says why, and the options are refused with `no_working_set`; a draft that is not a repair has no block.
- `php artisan test`: everything passes except `BuildStampTest`, which needs a build stamp a worktree lacks and passes in CI. PHPStan: no errors. Pint clean. Rebased on main after #393.

Companion PR: portal-android `workbench/policy-passkey`.
params.title: The app approves a repair-only policy draft by passkey
